evals.prompt: I got assigned #41, can you plan it out? the tab close thing
evals.expected_output: Fetches the ticket with comments, reads the tabs store and its tests, and prints a plan in the §4 shape: Decided cites a file, one Assumed line names the PM who owns the scroll-restore question, a Questions for others block, Verdict Needs info. Nothing written or posted; ends with the single §5 question.
assertions: The ticket was fetched with its comments (gh issue view --comments or comments in --json) before any plan was printed
The plan follows the section order Change, Kind, Risk, Decided, Assumed, Steps, Don't touch, Not doing, Done means, Questions for others, Verdict
Every Decided line ends with a file:line, doc, or commit it came from
The scroll-restore question appears under Questions for others addressed to the reporter, with the assumed answer stated
The Verdict line is Needs info and names the owner
Nothing was written to a file and nothing was posted; the run ends with one question that offers keep, write, post the plan, and post the questions

evals.prompt: what would it take to add a --json flag to scripts/validate_skills.py
evals.expected_output: No ticket fetched. Reads the validator and its test, prints a plan with Risk green, Decided citing validate_skills.py lines, no Questions for others block, Verdict Ready to build, and a Done means naming the unittest to add. No tracker call.
assertions: No tracker command ran and no label lookup ran
The plan has no Questions for others section and no post offer
The Risk line says green and names a reversal
Every Decided line cites scripts/validate_skills.py or tests/test_validate_skills.py with a line number, or a commit
The flag and its test are not split across two steps; a step carries its own test
Done means names the unittest command and a command that parses the --json output
The Verdict line is Ready to build
The offer lists keep-here and write-to-file only, and says building is a separate ask

evals.expected_output: Risk red with no tests covering the invoice path. Step 1 is a characterization test pinning current invoice totals; the behavior change is a later step. Done means names a runnable test. Verdict says red zone, human on every step.
assertions: The Risk line says red and the Verdict says human on every step
Step 1 is a characterization test that pins current invoice behavior, and the behavior change is a later step
Done means names a runnable test, not a claim that it works
Don't touch lists the invoice totals path or its existing tests
